appearances.snippet: UFO 120 writes, Andrew Wilson never served in the military. And according to Baron Coleman's reporting on August 9th, he misrepresented his military service.

verification.notes: The source transcript confirms that the anonymous commenter made the accusation and attributed it to Baron Coleman's August 9 reporting. Current public transcripts preserve conflicting clips: Wilson is quoted as saying he was in the Army for about a year and elsewhere answering that he did not serve; the later debate establishes only that he denied being an Army sniper. No authenticated service record or authoritative military source was located. The underlying claim that he never served therefore cannot be resolved from available evidence and is not treated as false or true.
